# Renegade Core Model Manager (RenegadeCMM) v1.6.1

> **Release Version**: `v1.6.1`  
> **Tag / Commit**: [`v1.6.1`](https://github.com/DevNullInc/RenegadeCMM/releases/tag/v1.6.1) (`a96d7a6`)  
> **Target**: Inter-Application Compatibility & RenegadeSwarm Daemon Bearer Authentication Handshake  

---

## Executive Summary

RenegadeCMM `v1.6.1` aligns inter-application communication with the **RenegadeSwarm** desktop daemon. Privileged daemon endpoints on port `5180` now require cryptographic Bearer authentication. RenegadeCMM discovers the local `daemon.token` on disk, attaches it to model ingest and window focus calls, detects Swarm path-confinement errors (`403 Forbidden`), and displays connection status in Settings without exposing raw token secrets to the renderer.

---

## Endpoint Authorization Matrix

| Call | Method | Auth Scheme | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `/api/health`, `/health`, `/api/status` | `GET` | None (Public) | Heartbeat, peer count, version. Unauthenticated. |
| `/api/ingest` | `POST` | `Authorization: Bearer <64-hex>` | Automatic single-model ingest notification. |
| `/api/models/scan` | `POST` | `Authorization: Bearer <64-hex>` | Fallback directory rescan notification. |
| `/api/window/focus` | `POST` | `Authorization: Bearer <64-hex>` | Programmatic desktop window focus / restore. |
| `/api/cmm/status` | `GET` | `Authorization: Bearer <64-hex>` | Daemon inspection route. |

---

## Upgrade & Launch Sequence

1. **Start Swarm first**: Launch RenegadeSwarm so its daemon initializes on port `5180` and writes `daemon.token`.
2. **Launch RenegadeCMM**: Navigate to **Settings** $\rightarrow$ **RenegadeSwarm Bridge**. Status should report `Connected` and `Token: Found`.
3. **Folder permissions**: Ensure download directories in CMM reside inside Swarm's configured root folders. If a path is outside Swarm's roots, ingest will return `403` (*"Model path is outside Swarm's allowed folder roots"*).
4. **Database State**: Operates on existing SQLite schema version 11 with no migrations required.

---

## Changes in this Release (`a96d7a6`)

- **Local Token Discovery (`swarmAuthToken.ts`)**:
  - Main process searches standard platform paths for `daemon.token`:
    - **Windows**: `%APPDATA%\RenegadeSwarm\daemon.token`
    - **macOS**: `~/Library/Application Support/RenegadeSwarm/daemon.token`
    - **Linux**: `~/.config/RenegadeSwarm/daemon.token` (also checks `~/.config/renegadeswarm/daemon.token`)
    - **Dev fallback**: `.renegadeswarm_security/daemon.token`
  - Validates format against `^[a-f0-9]{64}$`.
  - Caches token in memory for `ingest`, `scan`, and `focus` calls.
  - Intercepts HTTP `401 Unauthorized` on daemon restarts to flush cache, reload from disk once, and retry.
- **Path Confinement Handling (`swarmBridge.ts`)**:
  - Intercepts HTTP `403` from `/api/ingest` and surfaces: *"Model path is outside Swarm's allowed folder roots (Path Confinement)"*.
- **Strict Window Focus Failure (`swarmBridge.ts`)**:
  - Focus tries POST `/api/window/focus` $\rightarrow$ OS window handle $\rightarrow$ local desktop binary.
  - If all three methods fail, returns `{ success: false }` instead of masking failures.
- **Renderer Token Isolation (`SettingsTab.tsx`)**:
  - Bearer token stays in the Electron main process. Renderer only receives boolean presence status, diagnostic error copy, and the expected path with a copy-to-clipboard button.
- **CI Modernization**:
  - Upgraded GitHub Actions to `actions/checkout@v5` with `FORCE_JAVASCRIPT_ACTIONS_TO_NODE24: true`.
- **Test Suite**:
  - Added token discovery, bearer header, 401 retry, 403 path confinement, and mocked daemon unit tests. 125 tests passing across 21 test files.

## Post-Tag Fixes on `main` (Scheduled for `v1.6.2`)

The following commits landed on `main` after tag `v1.6.1` and are not included in the `v1.6.1` binary installer:
- **`adm-zip` Upgrade (`f72ba4a`)**: Bumps `adm-zip` from `0.6.0` to `0.6.1` (`npm audit: 0 vulnerabilities`).
- **Launcher Hardening (`fb1c6e8`)**: Refuses silent Node.js installations on Windows, decouples PyTorch from routine `start`, stamps lockfile hash in `.installed`, isolates Electron kill targets, and adds TCP port readiness polling.
